release.notes:
New since 0.3.1:

- Pinned sites are shared by all windows of an account: a new window opens with the same pinned sites, in the same order. Closing a pinned tab unloads the page and keeps its tile; "Unpin" removes the site.
- Cookie dialogs: the YouTube consent dialog is dismissed too.
- The sign-up form links to the terms of use and the privacy policy.
- A plain message when update information cannot be fetched.

macOS 11 or later, Apple silicon. The installer and the update are signed with a Developer ID and notarized by Apple.
